args.query: FastAPI CRUD API with SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM and Pydantic v2 schemas on SQLite

results.title: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 CRUD with dependency-injected sessions
results.summary: FastAPI routes backed by SQLAlchemy 2.x typed models, a per-request session dependency, and TestClient tests on SQLite.

results.title: FastAPI + Pydantic v2 validators, discriminated unions and serializers
results.summary: Pydantic v2 patterns in FastAPI that agents often get wrong: field_validator, model_validator, discriminated unions, computed_field and response_model filtering.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2 ORM rows serialized with Pydantic v2 from_attributes
results.summary: Map SQLAlchemy 2 models, expose nested relationships through Pydantic v2 schemas with from_attributes=True and a computed_field, and test them offline against in-memory SQLite.

results.title: FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy 2 on aiosqlite, tested offline with per-test in-memory DBs
results.summary: A FastAPI app using AsyncSession and async_sessionmaker on aiosqlite, tested with httpx.AsyncClient over ASGITransport, overriding the session dependency with a fresh in-memory database for each test.

results.title: Drizzle ORM + better-sqlite3 CRUD
results.summary: Typed schema, migrations-free table creation and CRUD with Drizzle on an in-memory SQLite database.

results.title: SQLModel + FastAPI CRUD with in-memory SQLite
results.summary: Full CRUD API with SQLModel table models, separate create/update schemas and a session dependency overridden for tests.

results.title: FastAPI endpoint with Pydantic v2 discriminated unions and Annotated validators
results.summary: Accept a tagged union of payment methods with Field(discriminator), add Annotated validators, and test the exact 422 error shapes offline with TestClient.

results.title: Alembic autogenerate compare_metadata drift check against SQLite
results.summary: Declare SQLAlchemy 2 models with a naming convention, then detect schema drift offline by diffing the live SQLite schema against the metadata with Alembic compare_metadata.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2 + Alembic programmatic migrations
results.summary: Alembic migrations driven from Python (upgrade, downgrade, autogenerate check) against SQLite, with SQLAlchemy 2 models.

results.title: FastAPI background tasks + dependency overrides
results.summary: FastAPI BackgroundTasks for post-response work, with dependency_overrides to swap services in tests.
